4 Bedroom House in Wellway Park

Contact agent for street address
4 3 2

Beautiful Family Home with Pool, Patio & Entertainment Area

This well-maintained double-story residence is situated in the established suburb of Wellway Park, Durbanville, and offers spacious family accommodation together with attractive indoor and outdoor entertainment areas.

Upon entering, the entrance area opens into a spacious open-plan lounge and dining room, creating a comfortable and welcoming living environment. The well-appointed kitchen features ample built-in cabinetry with stone countertops and is complemented by a separate scullery. A bedroom with an en-suite bathroom is conveniently situated on the ground floor, providing suitable accommodation for guests or family members requiring easy access to the main living areas.

A staircase from the lounge leads to the first-floor study, providing a dedicated area for work or study. A passage leading from the kitchen provides access to two further bedrooms, a guest bathroom, and the spacious main bedroom. The main bedroom comprises an en-suite bathroom and separate dressing room, providing a private and comfortable retreat.

The lounge opens onto a covered patio, which extends the living and entertainment space towards the garden. The patio leads to an outdoor entertainment area featuring a fire pit, swimming pool, storeroom and an outside WC with shower facilities. The garden and pool area provide a pleasant setting for outdoor relaxation and entertaining, while the overall layout offers a practical combination of family living, private accommodation and entertainment space.

Contact me to arrange a viewing opportunity.
